entries.question: Kgmu online book
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU) online, you can use one of the following official methods:

1. **Online Registration System (ORS):** Visit the national portal at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the department and date, enter patient details, and pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee.
2. **ABHA / Health Care Mobile App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection and booking flow.
3. **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

*Note: Online registration is mandatory, and the OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods. Please carry a valid referral if you are an outside-city patient visiting a specific department.*

To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), please note that online registration is mandatory. Here are the available booking methods:

1. **Online (ORS Portal):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the department and date, fill in your patient details, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee, and download your slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or appropriate Health Care mobile app, register with your mobile number, and follow the hospital appointment flow.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit a physical registration counter at KGMU with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to complete OTP verification, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your slip.

**Important Guidelines:**
- OPD timings: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM; closed on Sundays.
- The ticket/parchi counter closes sharply at 1:00 PM.
- Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. 
- Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for their specific department.

*Disclaimer: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline (0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333). Please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: Kya कल ओपीडी रहेगी
entries.answer:
कल ओपीडी खुली रहेगी या बंद, यह इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि कल कौन सा दिन या अवकाश है। 

KGMU में ओपीडी के सामान्य नियम इस प्रकार हैं:
- **सोमवार से शुक्रवार:** सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक।
- **शनिवार:** सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक।
- **रविवार और राजपत्रित (Gazetted) अवकाश:** ओपीडी और ओटी बंद रहती हैं, हालांकि **आपातकालीन (Emergency) सेवाएं 24/7 खुली रहती हैं।**

यदि आप किसी विशेष अवकाश के दिन के बारे में पूछ रहे हैं, तो कृपया [KGMU अवकाश सूची 2026](https://kgmu.org/guidelines.php) देखें या यह बताने की कृपा करें कि आप किस तारीख की बात कर रहे हैं।
